entradas.text: I came to the Grand National Assembly of Sordland to deliver a speech regarding the new Constitution and ask for the support of the Assembly before the upcoming vote.
I walked quickly through the corridors, giving my greetings to people on my way towards the parliamentary hall.
When I entered the hall, the Assembly was in complete chaos, with shouting and cursing between the parties. There was a heavy argument about a proposal made by an MP from NFP.

I took my seat inside the special area reserved for the ministers. Gloria was shouting from her seat at the centre of the hall as she hit the gavel three times, with each strike heavier than the one before.
<shout>"ORDER! ORDER!"</shout>
Despite her efforts, the argument continued for a couple of minutes before everybody took back to their seats and finally went quiet.
"Mr. Kibener, next time when I tell you to do so, either take your seat or leave the hall; so we can proceed with the procedures of this Assembly and continue our duties."
Some MP's from the NFP side shouted back at her in protest.
"Honorable ladies and gentlemen, if you allow me to continue..."
"We have the President here with us today. He has asked to give an important announcement."
I saw Kesaro Kibener standing up from his seat and shouting towards the members of the PFJP.
"Mr. Kibener! Calm yourself! Show respect to the procedures of this Assembly!"
She pointed at me.
"You have the floor, Mr. President."
The Assembly fell silent.
I walked to the stand as loud clapping started in the USP's side.
"Ladies and Gentlemen of the Grand National Assembly of Sordland! I am here today to raise important questions regarding our outdated Constitution."
entradas.menu: "Ladies and Gentlemen..."

entradas.text: "The Supreme Court holds too much power over our elected branches! They have been obstructing the law making process and has long plagued the democracy in Sordland. Tarquin Soll gave this power to the Court for the sole reason to protect the Constitution of the 20's, which leads us to fail in adapting to the new world..."
entradas.menu: "The Supreme Court holds too much power..."

entradas.text: "Our election threshold has harmed our democracy more than anything since the formation of our republic. As USP, we have governed for a long time and I can acknowledge that this success was partly the result of our current 10% percent threshold."
entradas.menu: "Our election threshold has harmed our democracy more than anything..."

entradas.text: "Perhaps it's not expected of me to say this, but the President holds too much authority in Sordish politics. In order to strengthen our democracy, we must be brave enough to point out the injustices and faults of our Constitution."
entradas.menu: "Perhaps it's not expected of me to say this, but the President holds too much authority..."

entradas.text: I continued.
"...Therefore, we propose changes to the Constitution to prepare Sordland for a more democratic era!"
entradas.menu: "...Therefore, we propose changes to the Constitution to prepare Sordland for a more democratic era!"

entradas.text: "We will break the Supreme Court's authority over constitutional changes."
entradas.menu: "We will break the Supreme Court's authority over constitutional changes."

entradas.text: "We will fix the loopholes that allows the presidents to exercise absolute veto over legislation."
entradas.menu: "We will fix the loopholes that allows the presidents to exercise absolute veto over legislation."

entradas.text: "We will rebalance the branches of government to ensure a more democratic process."
entradas.menu: "We will rebalance the branches of government to ensure a more democratic process."

entradas.text: "It is more important than ever that we stand united as a nation in these changing times. I call everybody to be part of the change our people have been calling for. We all want to make Sordland better, don't we? Let's embrace democracy and unite under the banner of our people, and surely Sordland will be great again!"
entradas.menu: Unity.

entradas.text: Loud noises came from USP and NFP seats.
"Mr. President, with all due respect, I believe Sordland is already democratic."
"Please don't interrupt me."
entradas.menu: "Please don't interrupt me."

entradas.text: "I'm not finished yet, Mrs. Tory."
entradas.menu: "I'm not finished yet, Mrs. Tory."

entradas.text: "Ladies and gentlemen of the Assembly! We must set aside our differences."
entradas.menu: "Ladies and gentlemen of the Assembly! We must set aside our differences."

entradas.text: I took a breath and continued.
"It is time to make a new Constitution together!"
entradas.menu: "It is time to make a new Constitution together!"

entradas.text: "I ask everyone to think clearly about our current situation. And join us for change."
entradas.menu: "I ask everyone to think clearly about our current situation. And join us for change."

entradas.text: "Ladies and Gentlemen, I demand your votes!"
entradas.menu: "Ladies and Gentlemen, I demand your votes!"

entradas.text: "Let's write the future together!"
entradas.menu: "Let's write the future together!"

entradas.text: "I ask everyone to support us in the upcoming vote."
entradas.menu: "I ask everyone to support us in the upcoming vote."

entradas.text: "Be part of a new era for Sordland. Join us and vote for our proposal."
entradas.menu: "Be part of a new era for Sordland. Join us and vote for our proposal."

entradas.text: "I will address all the problems of the past in my proposal!"
entradas.menu: "I will address all the problems of the past in my proposal!"

entradas.text: "USP will change and lead Sordland into the future!"
entradas.menu: "USP will change and lead Sordland into the future!"

entradas.text: "For justice in Sordland!"
entradas.menu: "For justice in Sordland!"

entradas.text: "For a democratic Sordland!"
entradas.menu: "For a democratic Sordland!"

entradas.text: "For a united Sordland!"
entradas.menu: "For a united Sordland!"

entradas.text: "For a free Sordland!"
entradas.menu: "For a free Sordland!"

entradas.text: The Assembly roared with all kinds of different reactions.
"Thank you, Mrs. Speaker."
"Thank you for the speech, Mr. President."
"Honorable Members of the Grand National Assembly of Sordland! I am here today to raise important questions regarding our outdated Constitution."
entradas.menu: "Honorable Members of Assembly..."

entradas.text: "Brothers and sisters! I am here today to raise important questions regarding our outdated Constitution."
entradas.menu: "Brothers and sisters..."

entradas.text: "Our Constitution doesn't adequately define or respect the separation of powers and the balance between the branches. In order to strengthen our democracy, we must be brave enough to point out the faults of our Constitution."
entradas.menu: "Our Constitution doesn't adequately define or respect the separation of powers..."

entradas.text: "Our elected Assembly has always been overshadowed by the executive and the designated judiciary branches in Sordland. The Grand National Assembly must be able to exercise its job properly and without obstruction. However, our current Constitution fails to guarantee this."
entradas.menu: "Our elected Assembly has always been overshadowed..."

entradas.text: "We must finally rewrite the Constitution of Soll and break our chains of the past!"
entradas.menu: "We must finally rewrite the Constitution of Soll and break our chains of the past!"

entradas.text: "I call everyone to stand by us to make historic changes to our Constitution and bring it to the standards of today's world!"
entradas.menu: "I call everyone to stand by us to make historic changes to our Constitution and bring it to the standards of today's world!"

entradas.text: Loud applauses came from PFJP seats.
Applauses came from USP and PFJP seats.
Applauses came from USP and PFJP seats.
I focused on...

"We must not be afraid of change. The world is changing, and Sordland needs the change it has earned after years of Sollism in the last decades. We will rewrite the old and make a constitution that would reflect the will of the people, and open the way for a democratic Sordland!"
entradas.menu: Change.

entradas.text: "The '29 Constitution was the product of a time of war. Now is a time for peace. As we must make peace between each other, we must strive for peace in the world. We need a more democratic constitution that would reflect the will of the people, and flourish in the upcoming times of peace and prosper!"
entradas.menu: Peace.

entradas.text: Just as I was about to continue speaking, Gloria Tory interrupted me.
I walked back to my seat as many MP's asked to speak. Frens Ricter was among them.
Suddenly Kesaro Kibener started yelling from his seat.
"Tarquin Soll will answer for the crimes committed during his rule! We will make sure of that!"
entradas.menu: "Tarquin Soll will answer for the crimes committed during his rule! We will make sure of that!"

entradas.text: "We will be removing the presidential decrees and leave lawmaking to the Assembly."
entradas.menu: "We will be removing the presidential decrees and leave lawmaking to the Assembly."

entradas.text: "We will make Sordland great again!"
entradas.menu: "We will make Sordland great again!"

entradas.text: "Let's embrace the future."
entradas.menu: "Let's embrace the future."

entradas.text: "We both know that our Constitution is flawed."
entradas.menu: "We both know that our Constitution is flawed."

entradas.text: "You don't believe that."
entradas.menu: "You don't believe that."

entradas.text: "Tarquin Soll and his efforts cannot be ignored. We must keep following the path he defined for Sordish people."
"I'm sure the Honorable Members of USP will see that the President is acting rash by allying with the opposition to destroy the culture of Sollism that established Sordland."
"That was the extent of my quick note. Thank you. The President has the floor."
The whole United Sordland Party stood up and started applauding.
Some applauses came from the PFJP and USP seats. Most of the others started to make loud noises again.
"Yes, Mr. Ricter."
"I would like to thank Mr. President for his speech. We, the People's Freedom and Justice Party, stand in agreement with the need for a more democratic Constitution."
"I would like to thank the Ladies and Gentlemen of the United Sordland Party for their more open attitude compared to past years."
"As long as Mr. President's words prove not to be just words, we will be behind this much needed movement for change. We welcome this attempt."
"I ask Mr. President to share the final contents of this proposal as soon as possible."
"Thank you, Mrs. Speaker."
<shout>"The President must have lost his mind to cooperate with the likes of you, Mr. Ricter!"</shout>
<shout>"You and PFJP are nothing but puppets of western interests!"</shout>
<shout>"ORDER!"</shout>
"Madame Speaker! I know you are in agreement with me as well. Don't stand idly there while this administration is making deals with snakes and undermine the integrity of Sor-"
"ORDER! Mr. Kibener! How many times do I need to say? You are speaking out of tu-"
"I demand to speak!"
"...Very well, Mr. Kibener... Go ahead."
"Mr. President!"
He looked directly at me.
"The nationalist movement does not agree with your priorities nor the way you're trying to implement them. The National Front Party will not stand with you on your new Constitution."
"Let it be known that the NFP's concerns are not included in this so called "democratic" reforms. Thus Mr. President has no right to claim them as such!"
"We will stand our ground against any attempt to bring down our established political culture and national values. Thank you."
Gloria gave him a stare. She looked annoyed.
Kesaro went back to his seat but the chaos in the Assembly continued.
I decided to leave the Assembly and its chaos behind.
entradas.menu: Leave the Assembly.

entradas.text: I asked to speak.
entradas.menu: Ask to speak.

entradas.text: I got up from my seat and started my walk towards the exit.
"Yes, Mr. President."
"Mr. Kibener..."
entradas.menu: "Mr. Kibener..."

entradas.text: "Mr. Ricter..."
entradas.menu: "Mr. Ricter..."

entradas.text: "I just wanted to thank everybody for their comments."
entradas.menu: "I just wanted to thank everybody for their comments."

entradas.text: I looked at him.
"It is you, who shouldn't use the word 'democratic' when you want a more centralized government."
entradas.menu: "It is you, who shouldn't use the word 'democratic' when you want a more centralized government."

entradas.text: "We are not specifically cooperating with someone, but everyone. We ask that you also join us."
entradas.menu: "We are not specifically cooperating with someone, but everyone. We ask that you also join us."

entradas.text: "I'm saddened to hear about your opposite stance."
entradas.menu: "I'm saddened to hear about your opposite stance."

entradas.text: He watched as he slouched on his seat, legs crossed.
"Do not stand against change! Be a part of it, Mr. Kibener! We can do much more together."
entradas.menu: "Do not stand against change! Be a part of it, Mr. Kibener! We can do much more together."

entradas.text: "Don't you dare stand against us! Otherwise, know that the NFP is guaranteed to be history."
entradas.menu: "Don't you dare stand against us! Otherwise, know that the NFP is guaranteed to be history."

entradas.text: "I respect your opinion."
entradas.menu: "I respect your opinion."

entradas.text: "We don't need you."
entradas.menu: "We don't need you."

entradas.text: "I expect your support in the upcoming vote, Mr. Kibener."
entradas.menu: "I expect your support in the upcoming vote, Mr. Kibener."

entradas.text: "We will bring change regardless of your support."
entradas.menu: "We will bring change regardless of your support."

entradas.text: "Thank you."
entradas.menu: "Thank you."

entradas.text: "Your times have passed, Mr. Kibener."
entradas.menu: "Your times have passed, Mr. Kibener."

entradas.text: Gloria looked at me to see if I'd finished my response.
"Thank you, Mrs. Speaker."
entradas.menu: "Thank you, Mrs. Speaker."

entradas.text: "Rest assured, your concerns will be addressed."
entradas.menu: "Rest assured, your concerns will be addressed."

entradas.text: I looked at him.
"We'd like to have cooperation between our parties."
entradas.menu: "We'd like to have cooperation between our parties."

entradas.text: "I welcome your positive attitude."
entradas.menu: "I welcome your positive attitude."

entradas.text: "I expect your support, Mr. Ricter! We can do much more together."
entradas.menu: "I expect your support, Mr. Ricter! We can do much more together."

entradas.text: "Thank you for your support. We are looking forward to work with the PFJP."
entradas.menu: "Thank you for your support. We are looking forward to work with the PFJP."

entradas.text: "Thank you for the nice words."
entradas.menu: "Thank you for the nice words."

entradas.text: Gloria looked at me to see if I'd finished my response.
"Alright, Mr. President."
MP's kept shouting and responding to each other, creating a loud mess where nothing was legible.
"Order! Order! This topic has finished. We are moving unto our next topic..."
I slowly left the hall. Thew shouting could be heard from every corridor of the Grand National Assembly.
I got up from my seat and started my walk towards the exit.
I slowly left the hall. The shouting could be heard from every corridor of the Grand National Assembly.
"There is a victory growing with every morning..."
entradas.menu: "There is a victory growing with every morning..."

entradas.text: I saluted the crowd.
entradas.menu: Salute the crowd.

entradas.text: "There is my country beyond everything, my beloved..."
entradas.menu: "There is my country beyond everything, my beloved..."

entradas.text: "There is God beyond existence or nonexistence..."
entradas.menu: "There is God beyond existence or nonexistence..."

entradas.text: "Fear not when the dark falls! There is an artist painting the sun."
entradas.menu: "Fear not when the dark falls! There is an artist painting the sun."

entradas.text: "Beyond the next morning, there is a victory waiting to be won."
entradas.menu: "Beyond the next morning, there is a victory waiting to be won."

entradas.text: "There is a spring that blossoms out of the graves of our fallen..."
entradas.menu: "There is a spring that blossoms out of the graves of our fallen..."

entradas.text: "There is a destiny above destiny..."
entradas.menu: "There is a destiny above destiny..."

entradas.text: I decided to read a poem before I ended my speech.
entradas.menu: Finish with a poem.

entradas.text: "Do not dare to surrender! There is a victory that grows with defeat."
entradas.menu: "Do not dare to surrender! There is a victory that grows with defeat."

entradas.text: "There are songs to be sung in affectation of our victories..."
entradas.menu: "There are songs to be sung in affectation of our victories..."

entradas.text: "There is a revolution that's coming..."
entradas.menu: "There is a revolution that's coming..."

entradas.text: "There is the evil that tortures and tears me down..."
entradas.menu: "There is the evil that tortures and tears me down..."

entradas.text: "Do not doubt the One! There is a decision coming from the heavens..."
entradas.menu: "Do not doubt the One! There is a decision coming from the heavens..."

entradas.text: "I'll act as if that didn't happen."
entradas.menu: "I'll act as if that didn't happen."

entradas.text: "Who are you trying to provoke, Mrs. Tory? USP is behind me."
entradas.menu: "Who are you trying to provoke, Mrs. Tory? USP is behind me."

entradas.text: "That was disrespectful Mrs. Speaker. Please don't try to sabotage my speech."
entradas.menu: "That was disrespectful Mrs. Speaker. Please don't try to sabotage my speech."

entradas.text: "We are not here to destroy Sollism nor our cultural values."
entradas.menu: "We are not here to destroy Sollism nor our cultural values."

entradas.text: "You've just promised to try Soll, Mr. President! You are talking about the founder of this party. He is the true founder of this republic."
"What crimes are you talking about? You owe everything you have to him. This is unacceptable!"
Loud noises came from USP and NFP seats.
"Everyone! Please! Let me finish."
entradas.menu: "Everyone! Please! Let me finish."

entradas.text: "Hear me out."
entradas.menu: "Hear me out."

entradas.text: "Please continue your speech, Mr. President."
"Let me explain."
entradas.menu: "Let me explain."

entradas.text: The whole United Sordland Party stood up and started shouting at me.
"Your time is finished. Please take your seat, Mr. President."
